angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Private companies can improve public services by adding competition and focusing on profit.

angles.label: Point 2

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Privatization can make essential services too expensive for the general public, as exemplified by a water company raising prices, which harms poor families.

modelPlan.focus: Evaluate the benefits and drawbacks of privatizing public sector undertakings and determine if it is beneficial to society.
keyArguments: Privatization can lead to improved efficiency and better resource allocation through market forces.
However, privatization may result in reduced public accountability and potential negative social equity impacts.
